What problem it solves: Small business owners are overwhelmed by repetitive operational tasks.
Business owner appearance: A seamless, invisible assistant that handles DMs and tasks via a 375px mobile UI feed without complex configurations.
Advantages/Risks: Advantage is up to 80% reduction in operational burden; risk is high reliance on LLM confidence scoring for auto-execution.
Pricing: Included within the platform's multi-tenant tier limits.
Cloud/Standalone support: Supported seamlessly across cloud and local-first architectures via the KAIROS Orchestrator.
